title_as_printed: Measured Bunsen coefficients alpha (x 10^3) for pure nitrogen in sea water together with computed values and differences.
pressure_note: Bunsen coefficient defined at a gas pressure of 760 Torr (gas partial pressure, water-vapour-saturated gas used; total pressure in apparatus held constant at about atmospheric and not needed)

composition.other_species: natural sea water (Irish Sea surface water S about 35 permil) diluted with distilled water or concentrated by distilling off about 10 percent; salinity by inductive salinometer; chlorinity column (permil) also given, Cl = S/1.8065 style relation from Knudsen tables; sea-water matrix, not a six-ion composition

extra_unmapped: Chlorinity (permil) (derived from salinity, Knudsen Hydrographic Tables)
Smoothed curve value (alpha x 10^3 from the authors' fitted curve; model-generated)
Difference (measured minus smoothed curve value, x 10^3)
conversion_needs: Bunsen coefficient (cm3 STP per cm3 solvent at T under 760 Torr gas pressure) to mole fraction needs solvent density (computed by authors from salinity via Knudsen tables) and molar volume at STP
salinity per mil to molality needs sea-water composition assumption
notes: Temperature printed once per block of 5 (or 6) rows beside the middle row; filled down into the Temp. column for every row (carried-forward).
